heading: INT. RIVERSIDE SOUND STUDIO - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. RIVERSIDE SOUND STUDIO - CONTROL ROOM - NIGHT
A dim room, all faders and foam.
Through the glass: a vocal booth, a lone mic, a stool.

ELLIE (17, borrowed leather jacket two sizes too big) stands inside the booth with headphones clamped on, gripping the mic stand while RHYS (30s, producer, beanie, tea in a chipped mug) slumps behind the desk with his feet up, and a laptop on his knee pings and BUZZES every few seconds as GRAN's name flashes on its screen.
Again, Ellie. From the second verse.
units.name: RHYS

units.text: I've done it nine times, Rhys.
units.name: ELLIE

units.text: Ten's a good number.
units.name: RHYS

units.text: She sighs, the speaker crackling.
Rhys's phone rings: GRAN.
He answers, puts it on speaker.
Rhys, love, is she there? She's not answering her mobile.
units.name: GRAN

units.text: She's singing, Gran. Can't be disturbed.
units.name: RHYS

units.text: Tell her the dinner's gone cold. Tell her I'm proud, and the dinner's gone cold.
units.name: GRAN

units.text: Ellie hears it through the cans.
Her hand goes to her mouth.
Rhys mutes the line and presses talkback.
Good. Hold that. Sing it like that.
units.name: RHYS

units.text: She takes a breath.
Closes her eyes.
The red light flicks on.
